name: cadforge
description: LLM-powered engineering 3D model generator with real-scale guarantees

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "bun run --cwd server dev" "bun run --cwd client dev" "bun run --cwd cad-worker dev"
scripts.dev:no-worker: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "bun run --cwd server dev" "bun run --cwd client dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd shared build && bun run --cwd server build && bun run --cwd client build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
